rule: PASS only if B loses on no system. B loses a system when B hits on fewer seeds and the two-sided Fisher exact p is below 0.05, or when the median energy calls to a hit on hitting runs is higher for B than for A, the two-sided exact Mann-Whitney p is below 0.05, and that median difference is strictly larger than the A/A band. The A/A band is the larger of the two median-call differences between a second copy of arm A and the first, on LJ38 and LJ75, at the same twelve seeds. Marginal losses use the same tests at p below 0.1 and are listed separately. A marginal loss does not change the verdict.
